Name: PrismaticShardCrafting
Author: XellorYT
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
This mod introduces a lore-friendly, well-balanced way to craft a Prismatic Shard in Stardew Valley. The recipe isn't simply handed to you; you have to earn the town blacksmith's trust to receive the secret blueprints of his grandfather.

[b]Main Features[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Lore-Friendly Unlock:[/b] Reach 8 hearts of friendship (2000 points) with Clint to receive a letter containing his grandfather's secret blueprints and a bonus diamond to kickstart your crafting.
[/*]
[*][b]Balanced Recipe:[/b] Crafting a Prismatic Shard requires 10 of each precious gem (Emerald, Aquamarine, Ruby, Amethyst, Topaz, Jade, and Diamond). This preserves the item's high value and keeps game progression intact.
[/*]
[*][b]Immersive Discovery:[/b] The morning after reading the letter, your character "recalls" the knowledge: the game automatically teaches you the recipe and triggers atmospheric on-screen notifications ([i]"Waking up, you remembered Clint's blueprints..."[/i] and [i]"You can create a Prismatic Shard!"[/i]).
[/*]
[*][b]Localization:[/b] Fully localized with built-in support for both English and Russian languages.
[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements[/b]
To ensure the mod and all custom triggers function properly, make sure you have the following prerequisites installed:

[list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] (the mod loader).
[/*]
[*][b]Content Patcher[/b] — the core framework for loading the content pack.
[/*]
[*][b]SpaceCore[/b] — required to display the on-screen HUD notification messages.
[/*]
[*][b]Esca's Modding Plugins (EMP)[/b] — required for the trigger, which handles the delayed second notification at 6:10 AM.
[/*]
[/list][b]Installation Instructions[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Ensure you have SMAPI and all required mods installed.
[/*]
[*]Download the mod archive.
[/*]
[*]Extract the mod folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]directory (default path:
[code].../Steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]).
[/*]
[*]Launch the game using
[code]StardewModdingAPI.exe[/code].
[/*]
[/list][b]Shout Outs[/b]
A massive thank you to the creators of Content Patcher, SpaceCore, and Esca's Modding Plugins for developing the powerful tools that make complex custom triggers possible. Shout out to the entire Stardew Valley modding community for their constant inspiration!

Manifest.Name: Craft Prismatic Shard
Manifest.Description: Adds a recipe to craft a Prismatic Shard from 10 of each precious gem.
